# Pranjal Garg

Pranjal Garg studies learning, neural dynamics, and computation in biological and artificial systems.

## Published research
- [Generalized contrastive PCA](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012747): Published in PLOS Computational Biology in 2025; the linked paper provides the full text and citation metadata.

## Research projects
- [Spontaneous Context Restoration](https://neurogarg.github.io/research.html#spontaneous-context-restoration): How language models recover from corrupted inputs, and whether intermediate representations predict recovery.
- [MetaLex: metaphors across vision and language](https://neurogarg.github.io/research.html#metalex): A benchmark testing whether vision-language models recover the same figurative meanings from matched images and text.
- [Active vision in Drosophila](https://neurogarg.github.io/research.html#active-vision): How retinal movements and neural activity let an animal reshape its own sensory input.
- [Co-adaptive biological–artificial intelligence](https://neurogarg.github.io/research.html#co-adaptive-intelligence): How heterogeneous learners specialize, share representations, and reorganize after perturbation.
